candidates.change_summary: Changed the condition so payout occurs when random == 1 instead of random == 0 (flips winner branch), which alters pot after play.
Removed the line that resets pot to 0 after a payout, so pot remains different after play.
Changed pot update to add only (TICKET_AMOUNT - FEE_AMOUNT) instead of msg.value, altering pot after play.
Inserted an extra pot reset to 0 immediately after incrementing pot, changing pot observed after play.
Changed the increment to subtract msg.value from pot instead of adding, making pot differ after play.
Replace condition so payout occurs when random == 1 instead of random == 0, changing when pot is transferred and thus play() observable state.
Replace transfer order so contract pays player first then bank; this can change reentrancy outcomes and thus the observed final pot.
Replace pot update to subtract ticket amount on entry instead of adding, altering resulting pot value after play() returns.
Replace the reset of pot to set it to the ticket amount instead of zero, changing pot visible after play().
